The background consists of clean white wall panels, creating a professional and minimalist environment. The lighting in the animation is soft and indoor, contrasting with the studio setting. She then transitions into a focused posture, her hands hovering over the keys as she prepares to play. The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot throughout this sequence.
